title: File Naming
slide_intent: Separate asset-management guidance from design rules so readers can find the practical information needed to select files.
strategic_value: A clear File Naming divider can make Burger King’s production reference easier to navigate.
demonstration: A large orange File Naming heading occupies the upper portion of a brown page above open space and the small legal footer.
practical_value: Find the transition into the asset filename convention without confusing it with a visual application example.

content_islands.spec: Set the orange title in one prominent line on the brown field.
